title: A Proclamation to Approve the Loan Agreement Between the Government of Eritrea and the OPEC Fund for International Development 100/1997
text:
Proclamation No. 100/1997
A Proclamation to Approve the Loan
Agreement between the Government of
Eritrea and the OPEC Fund for International
Development
WHEREAS, a Loan Agreement between the Government of Eritrea and the OPEC
Fund for International Development, stipulating that the OPEC Fund for
International Development provide to the Government of Eritrea a loan amounting
to US Dollars six million (6,000,000. =) to assist in the financing of the Asmara
Water Supply Project was signed at Vienna, Austria, on the 22nd of August, 1997;
and
WHEREAS, the Loan Agreement has been ratified by the President of the State of
Eritrea;
NOW, THEREFORE, in accordance with Article 6(4) (c) of the Definition of
Powers and Duties of the Government of Eritrea Proclamation No.37/1993, it is
hereby proclaimed as follows:
1. Short Title
This Proclamation may be cited as the "OPEC Fund for International
Development Loan Agreement to assist in the Financing of the Asmara Water
Supply Project Approval Proclamation No.100/1997".
2. Definition
In this Proclamation "Loan Agreement" means the Loan Agreement signed at
Vienna. Austria, on the 22nd of August, 1997, between the Government of
Eritrea and the OPEC Fund for International Development.
3. Power of the Ministers of Finance and Land Water and Environment
The Ministers of Finance and Land, Water and Environment are hereby jointly
and severally empowered to undertake all acts for the utilization of the loan
amounting to US Dollars six million (US$ 6,000,000. =) in accordance with the
terms and conditions set forth in the Loan Agreement.
4. Effective Date
This Proclamation shall enter into force on the date of its publication in the
Gazette of Eritrean Laws.
Done at Asmara, this 28" day of October, 1997.
Issaias Afwerki,
President of the State of Eritrea.
